name: The Mithril Order
label: Quest
description: The Mithril Order: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Most of our recruits never make it to Booty Bay, friend. The shine of the insignia is enough to trigger the loot lust in even the staunchest of blacksmiths. Fools they be, as the insignia is a drop in the bucket compared to the wealth of items you'll see!
Find Galvan the Ancient and show him this pin. His residence is far to the north, between Zul Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail! Come closer; show Galvan what you have.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, many years it has been since one has been worthy of the Mithril Order's initiation. We will start now!
